questions.question: Review or add frontend features for the ICT portal.
questions.answer: Classes 6–8; Hindi and English; static JSON content; chapter notes and question banks; question-paper generation; print and Word-compatible DOCX export; Tailwind CSS; deployment to Vercel or Cloudflare Pages. Use only a fixed syllabus and content confirmed from available source material; do not invent missing syllabus topics or assets.
questions.rationale: These capabilities were specified by the user; textbook content must be transcribed or summarized from the user's PDFs and verified before inclusion.
questions.recommendedChoice: Classes 6–8; Hindi and English; static JSON content; chapter notes and question banks; question-paper generation; print and Word-compatible DOCX export; Tailwind CSS; deployment to Vercel or Cloudflare Pages.

questions.question: Please provide the authoritative ICT book PDFs for Classes 6, 7, and 8 (upload them here or add them to the workspace), and identify the board/curriculum, edition/year, and language for each. One PDF is currently present in the workspace: `ictclass6.pdf` (in the chat-attachments folder). Confirm whether that is the correct Class 6 source. No Class 7 or 8 PDFs were found. The existing Class 6 JSON files are unverified and will not be treated as authoritative unless checked against the PDFs.
questions.answer: Confirm the Class 6 PDF and provide the Class 7 and Class 8 PDFs with their board/curriculum and edition/year.
questions.rationale: The user requires content derived from their books. Only one Class 6 PDF is currently available; no authoritative Class 7/8 source has been identified.

questions.answer: All learning content and generated papers in both Hindi and English, with a bilingual interface.
questions.rationale: The user specified Hindi and English, but whether each content item must be translated into both languages is not yet confirmed.

options.description: Each chapter resource and assessment is available in both languages.

questions.question: The portal should add helpful details omitted by the books without presenting invented or unsupported claims. How should supplemental material be sourced and shown?
questions.answer: Add age-appropriate supplemental details from approved, reliable references; label them separately from book-derived content and cite sources.

options.label: Add age-appropriate supplemental details from approved, reliable references; label them separately from book-derived content and cite sources
options.description: Keep textbook-derived notes distinct and attach source citations to supplemental explanations.

options.description: The portal can clarify book topics, but all substantive content must be supported by the PDFs.

options.description: Use only the references named by the user and distinguish them from textbook-derived content.

questions.recommendedChoice: Add age-appropriate supplemental details from approved, reliable references; label them separately from book-derived content and cite sources.

questions.question: Which assessment question formats should quizzes, tests, and generated Unit Tests include?
questions.answer: Balanced mix: multiple choice, true/false, fill in the blanks, matching, short answer, and long answer.
questions.rationale: The user requested quizzes/tests and Unit Test generation but has not specified their question formats.

options.label: Balanced mix: multiple choice, true/false, fill in the blanks, matching, short answer, and long answer
options.description: A flexible classroom-ready mix; the paper generator can fit question types to selected chapters and marks.

options.label: Objective questions plus short answer
options.description: Focus on multiple choice, true/false, fill in the blanks, matching, and brief responses.

options.label: I will specify formats
options.description: Use freeform input to list the preferred question types and any class-specific restrictions.

questions.recommendedChoice: Balanced mix: multiple choice, true/false, fill in the blanks, matching, short answer, and long answer.

questions.question: Should quizzes/tests and generated Unit Test papers include answer keys or marking guidance?
questions.answer: Include a separate answer key and concise marking guidance, hidden from the student-facing printable paper by default.
questions.rationale: Answer keys and marking guidance were not specified.

options.label: Include a separate answer key and concise marking guidance
options.description: Keep the student paper printable without answers; provide a separate teacher key.

options.label: Include answers and explanations with each quiz; keep generated Unit Test answers separate
options.description: Use immediate feedback for practice and a separate key for formal tests.

options.label: No answer keys
options.description: Generate questions and papers only.

questions.recommendedChoice: Include a separate answer key and concise marking guidance, hidden from the student-facing printable paper by default.

questions.question: For the Unit Test generator, should the selected chapters, total marks, and exam duration be enough to create a balanced draft automatically, or should students also configure the question-type/mark distribution?
questions.answer: Automatically create a balanced draft from selected chapters, marks, and duration, with optional adjustment of question types and marks before print/export.
questions.rationale: The required inputs are known, but the default distribution and amount of user control are not.

options.label: Automatically create a balanced draft, with optional adjustment before print/export
options.description: Use chapter selection, total marks, and duration as the required inputs; offer optional question-type and mark-distribution controls.

options.label: Require users to set question types and marks per type
options.description: Provide more control but require additional configuration beyond chapters, total marks, and duration.

options.label: Use my own paper-generation rules
options.description: Describe required mark distribution, question counts, difficulty, and any class-specific restrictions.

questions.recommendedChoice: Automatically create a balanced draft from selected chapters, marks, and duration, with optional adjustment of question types and marks before print/export.
